productCapabilities.reason: Delegated user access remains excluded from 1.0 until OAuth 2.1 consent, refresh rotation, revocation, redirect policy, and acting-user audit are qualified together.
Provider-neutral call metadata and actions remain excluded from 1.0 until permissions, retention, and provider-secret isolation have one stable contract.
Explicit file-share grants remain excluded from 1.0 until expiry, revoke, download authorization, and audit semantics are qualified without exposing object-storage identifiers.
Order lifecycle remains excluded from 1.0 until totals, immutable price snapshots, finance permissions, idempotency, and transition rules form one stable domain contract.
Report jobs remain excluded from 1.0 until saved-query inputs, bounded result schemas, retention, export delivery, and cancellation are stable across report families.
Import jobs remain excluded from 1.0 until secure upload, validate/preview/execute, row-level errors, idempotency, cancellation, and rollback policy are qualified together.
Raw storage access bypasses domain and tenant policy.
Generic method execution is not a stable public contract.
Shell, migration, reset, and health controls remain operator-only.
Provider, billing, authentication, and storage secrets are never public data.
Execution documents remain hidden behind safe automation resources.
Device and object-storage protocols remain implementation details.
